text: Professional Positioning and Training ObjectivesThe major of administrative management is an interdisciplinary subject that takes the management activities of public organizations, government agencies and enterprises and institutions as its research object. It integrates knowledge from multiple disciplines such as political science, management, law and sociology, aiming to cultivate compound management talents with systematic management thinking, policy analysis ability and practical operation skills.Core training objectives:Master the basic theories, policies, regulations and modern management methods of administrative management;Possess practical abilities such as organization and coordination, official document writing, public decision-making, and crisis management;Be capable of engaging in administrative affairs, human resources, policy research and other management work in Party and government organs, public institutions, social organizations and enterprises.
